chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Wasshash, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no harm in a man drinking from a cup with a crack, but keep your mouth away from the place of the silver.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to drink from a cracked cup with silver inlay?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the permissibility of using cracked vessels, provided the defect does not render the drink impure (*najis*) or cause harm. The specific instruction to avoid the silver inlay (*fiḍḍah*) highlights the Shia juristic focus on both physical cleanliness and the prevention of *ishtibāh* (confusion) with precious materials, ensuring the vessel remains suitable for regular use.
